howToUse.title: How to Use BookEase
howToUse.subtitle: Learn how to get the most out of our booking platform, whether you're a client or a business owner
howToUse.clientGuideSubtitle: Follow these easy steps to book your next appointment
howToUse.businessGuideSubtitle: Everything you need to run your booking business efficiently

client.step1Desc: Use our powerful search to find services by name, category, or location. Filter by wilaya and city to find businesses near you.
client.step2Desc: View detailed business profiles including services offered, staff members, working hours, portfolio gallery, and customer reviews.
client.step3Desc: Select from available staff members based on their expertise, ratings, and availability for your chosen service.
client.step4Desc: View the real-time availability calendar and select a time slot that works best for your schedule.
client.step5Desc: Review your booking details and confirm. You'll receive notifications about your appointment status.

business.step1Desc: Sign up as a business owner and create your business profile with details like name, category, location, and contact information.
business.step2Desc: Add the services you offer with descriptions, prices, and duration. Clients will see these when browsing your profile.
business.step3Desc: Invite staff members by their User ID. Assign services to each staff member and manage their permissions.
business.step4Desc: Set your business hours for each day of the week. Staff can also set their individual availability.
business.step5Desc: View and manage all bookings from your dashboard. Confirm, reschedule, or cancel appointments as needed.
business.step6Desc: Monitor your business performance with detailed analytics including booking trends, revenue, and top services.
